findings.evidence: Basic.lean:628 has `@[simp] theorem chartValuesL_apply ... := (rfl)`. Basic.lean:691 and 718 use `simpa only [chartValuesL_apply] using congrFun ... i`. No heterogeneous-order version exists on main (a grep for `chartValueL_eq_of` found only this PR).
findings.fix: Move it to `Sobolev/Basic.lean` as a public lemma about an arbitrary `C` at orders k and k'. Prove it with `by simpa only [chartValuesL_apply] using congrFun h i`, the pattern of `chartValueL_lowerOrdersL` and `chartValueL_eqRec`.
findings.issue: `chartValueL_eq_of_chartValuesL_eq` is a general fact about any `SectionChartData` (equal `chartValuesL` at orders k and k' give equal `chartValueL` in each chart). It is private, specialized to `A.tangentHom`, and proved by a chain of `chartValuesL_apply`, `.symm`, `.trans` and `congrFun`.

findings.evidence: Lines 142-143 of the new file; `chartValuesL_apply` is a `@[simp]` lemma proved by rfl (Basic.lean:627-630).
findings.fix: Prove it with `funext fun i ↦ by simpa only [chartValuesL_apply] using hζξ i`. Better, state both directions as one `iff` lemma in `Sobolev/Basic.lean` next to `chartValuesL_injective`.
findings.issue: The global theorem proves the reverse direction (equal `chartValueL` in every chart gives equal `chartValuesL` at different orders) inline as `funext fun i ↦ ((chartValuesL_apply ..).trans (hζξ i)).trans (chartValuesL_apply ..).symm`. This is the same brittle chain, run the other way.

summary: The proofs are short and readable, but a general fact about chart data across Sobolev orders is hidden in a private, `A.tangentHom`-specific helper. That helper and its reverse direction, proved inline in the global theorem, are long `.trans` chains instead of the `simpa only [chartValuesL_apply]` pattern `Sobolev/Basic.lean` already uses.
